summary: Full e2e test of LinkedLeads.ai CRM + Extension API. Backend: 32 pytest cases across /api/crm-auth/* and /api/ext/* (login, me, users, RBAC, lockout, CORS, stats, session, campaigns CRUD, task polling/result, XLSX upload, ZIP download) - 27 passed. Frontend: Playwright e2e on /linkedin-crm covering login (valid+invalid), dashboard stat cards, all 6 nav views, campaign create/expand/pause/resume/delete, XLSX upload via UI, prospects filter+search, extension view, settings, admin table, logout - all flows work except 2 defects below. Extension itself (Chrome) not testable in this env; its API surface fully verified.

critical.issue: Endpoint DOES NOT EXIST (404). SettingsView.jsx calls it on 'Save Cookies', so the manual LinkedIn cookie feature is completely non-functional. UI surfaces the raw 'Not Found' string as the user message.

minor.issue: Malformed task_id (non-ObjectId, e.g. 'not-an-objectid') raises bson InvalidId -> HTTP 500. Should be 400/404. ObjectId(task_id) at ext_api.py:117 is unguarded.
Corrupt/non-XLSX file body -> HTTP 500 (openpyxl.load_workbook raises unhandled). Should return 400 with a clear message; the UI then shows a generic 'Upload failed' alert.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' path yields allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests against wildcard; violates auth playbook requirement of explicit origins.
Unauthenticated - anyone can download the extension package. Consider requiring auth.

Only password_hash is projected out; li_at / jsessionid LinkedIn session cookies of every user are returned in plaintext to the admin UI. Should be redacted to a has_cookie boolean (as _user_to_dict does).
Seed only inserts when user is absent; it never updates an existing user's password_hash/role. Playbook requires seed to update the admin if DEFAULT_PASSWORD changed.
Sets crm_access_token with samesite='none' while /login sets samesite='lax' - inconsistent cookie attributes across the same cookie name.

Docstring says 'from this user's active campaigns' but the query only filters status='pending' with no campaign-status join. Works today only because pause() flips task status, so semantics are implicit/fragile.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful XLSX upload the alert says 'Added 2 prospects!' and the header count updates to '2 prospects', but the expanded task table still shows 'No prospects yet. Upload an XLSX file to add them.' Root cause: fetch effect is gated on `expanded && tasks.length === 0` with `tasks.length` as a dep; onDone() calls setTasks([]) which does not change tasks.length, so the effect never re-runs. Users must collapse and re-expand the card.
'Save Cookies' fails (404) and displays the bare backend string 'Not Found' inside the message banner - no meaningful error copy.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend calls POST /api/crm-auth/update-cookies which is not implemented in the backend -> 404 on every attempt.
Task list not re-fetched after upload (see ui_bugs).

issues: Sidebar is a hard-coded w-60 (240px) flex item with no responsive collapse/hamburger - it consumes 61% of a 390px viewport, squeezing main content to ~150px
Stat card labels ('Connects Today', 'Total Completed') are horizontally clipped on mobile
Prospect/task tables are unusable at mobile width
'Sign Out' label uses text-slate-400 on white (~2.8:1 contrast) - below WCAG AA 4.5:1
Inactive nav labels use text-slate-500, borderline for small text

Campaign dropdown has no 'All campaigns' option, so the promised 'table of all prospects' is never reachable - it always shows a single campaign (defaults to first, which may have 0 rows and looks empty)
Pause/Resume/Delete icon buttons and the campaign filter/search inputs have no data-testid; only title attributes are available for automation
window.confirm / window.alert used for delete confirmation and upload result instead of an in-app dialog/toast

action_items: Implement POST /api/crm-auth/update-cookies (persist li_at/jsessionid on crm_users, return {success:true}) - Settings page is broken without it
Fix CampaignCard task refresh after XLSX upload: replace the `tasks.length === 0` gating with an explicit refreshKey/loaded flag so onDone() re-fetches tasks
Guard ObjectId(task_id) in POST /api/ext/tasks/{id}/result -> return 400/404 instead of 500
Wrap openpyxl.load_workbook in try/except in upload-prospects -> 400 'Invalid spreadsheet file' instead of 500
Set explicit CORS origins (not '*') since allow_credentials=True
Make seed_crm_users idempotent-with-update for the super_admin password/role
Add responsive sidebar (hidden below md + hamburger) and fix mobile layout
Add 'All Campaigns' option to the Prospects campaign filter
Add data-testid to pause/resume/delete campaign buttons
Raise contrast of 'Sign Out' and inactive nav labels to >=4.5:1
critical_code_review_comments: ext_api.py:117 - ObjectId(task_id) is unguarded; any malformed id from the extension returns 500.

ext_api.py:334 - openpyxl.load_workbook on untrusted upload without try/except; also no file-extension/size validation despite the UI accepting .csv (a .csv upload will 500 since openpyxl cannot parse it).
ext_api.py:337 - `next(ws.iter_rows(...))` will raise StopIteration/RuntimeError on an empty sheet.

ext_api.py:341-351 - header mapping uses if/elif with substring matching; a header like 'Company Name' matches 'name' first only because 'company' is checked earlier - fragile and silently mis-maps columns.
crm_auth.py:229 - list_users projects out only password_hash, leaking li_at/jsessionid session cookies.
crm_auth.py:195 - refresh() uses samesite='none' whereas login uses 'lax' for the same cookie.
CRMDashboard.jsx is 888 lines with 8 components in one file - split into per-view modules (>700 line guideline).
CRMDashboard.jsx:293 - effect dependency on `tasks.length` creates the stale-empty-table bug after upload; use an explicit version counter.
ext_api.py:23 / crm_auth.py:20 - each route module creates its own AsyncIOMotorClient; share one client to avoid connection-pool duplication.
No pagination on GET /api/ext/campaigns (limit 100) or /tasks (limit 500) - will silently truncate at scale.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Settings cookie save: SettingsView.jsx:672 POSTs /api/crm-auth/update-cookies, but crm_auth.py defines no such route (only login/logout/me/refresh/change-password/users CRUD) -> 404 on every save. 2) Stale task table after upload: CampaignCard's useEffect (CRMDashboard.jsx:292-300) fires only when `expanded && tasks.length === 0`, with deps [expanded, ax, campaign_id, tasks.length]. UploadButton's onDone calls setTasks([]) - length stays 0, so no dep changes and React skips the effect; the newly inserted tasks are never fetched. 3) The two 500s are unguarded external-input parsing: bson.ObjectId() on a path param and openpyxl.load_workbook() on an arbitrary upload body.
